Whether the planner route serves at population level is the arm's own delta-consumption table, never four rows.

gate.closed_when: the candidate list is non-empty AND the majority scenario is one the gate names. A closed gate returns None -- no supply step at all for that node on that row -- so the wave seals as an ordinary organize step rather than an empty acquisition.
gate.majority: most-frequent, not strictly-more-than-half. Ties are broken by the scenario whose FIRST OCCURRENCE in the candidate list is earliest.
gate.not_declared_on: perception -- the CELL-2 unconditional route is REMOVED, not gated. The Perception node PRODUCES the candidate list, so nothing exists to gate on when it is served, and the unconditional validator's key set is an EQUALITY, so a scenario_gate there is refused by construction.
gate.open_changes_nothing: control falls through to the identical selection; the supply is byte-identical to the ungated route's (same selected ids, same RankResult hash, same FusionDecision hash, same action_target_ref). Proved by tests/unit/test_stage3_scenario_gate.py::test_an_open_gate_is_byte_identical_to_the_ungated_route.

receipts.decision: route.receipt['delta_scenario_gate'], EVERY decision open and closed: node, phase, sample id, store id, policy id, gated scenarios, majority scenario, candidate count, closed. Published only when some route declares a gate. Labels, identities and counts only -- no utterance, transcript, gold label, candidate text or statement is ever written.
receipts.skip: route.receipt['delta_supply'], the existing per-row skip audit, with reason = 'scenario-gate-closed' and a majority_scenario label declared LAST and omitted when absent, so every ungated cell's skip receipt is byte-identical to its pre-iteration-3 self

gate.registry: core.base.STAGE3_SUPPLY_GATE_POLICIES, populated from rails/knowledge_provider.py beside the delta provider ids; resolved by rails.knowledge_provider.resolve_scenario_gate and checked BY PATH by scripts/checks/engineering_base_check.py
gate.scenario_of_intent: the part before the first underscore, the SLURP catalog's own composition rule (general_quirky -> general, iot_hue_lightoff -> iot); rails.stage3_delta_supply.scenario_of_intent
gate.what_it_reads: the SAME projected Perception candidate list the route already reads -- after the bounded first-occurrence projection (max 3 candidates), before any store lookup -- and nothing else. Only the sealed Perception state of the same episode. No gold, no reference transcript, no scorer, no future turn, no other row.

projection_from_the_sealed_comparator.note_on_the_two_gated_scenarios_absent_f: alarm and music carry ZERO gold rows on DEV-2000-ADDED, so two of the seven gated strata cannot contribute a gold row at all. They still gate rows: the gate reads the PREDICTED majority candidate scenario, and the projection puts 21 rows at alarm and 42 at music. That asymmetry -- gating on a predicted label that the roster's gold does not carry -- is registered here before contact as a known property of the mechanism on this venue.
projection_from_the_sealed_comparator.what_this_is: A MODEL-FREE PROJECTION, not a measurement of this cell: the gate outcome each DEV-2000-ADDED row would take if its Perception candidates were the ones the SEALED comparator itself produced. Computed from SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-DEFAULT-PLAN-DEV2000-ADDED-V1's own sealed phase states (intent ids only), projected with the route's bounded first-occurrence rule at max 3 candidates and reduced by rails.stage3_delta_supply.majority_candidate_scenario. Zero contacts. CELL-3's Perception request is byte-identical to the comparator's for the same row -- the Perception delta route is REMOVED -- so the projection is close, but greedy decoding is not bit-reproducible across batch compositions, so the realised share is MEASURED by the consumption read and never assumed.
